Name: Instant Farm Cleanup And Debris Remover
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Tidy Farm
[/b][/size]
[i]The instant farm cleanup tool

[/i][/center][center][size=3]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.

[/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/url][/size][/center]


[quote]Items are deleted directly from the map, meaning you will not receive resources like wood or stone in your inventory. This is necessary to prevent game crashes and severe lag spikes that occur when spawning thousands of item drops at once.[/quote]

[size=4][b]Description
[/b][/size]
Are you tired of spending your first week in Stardew Valley hacking away at stones and weeds? Do you want to redesign your layout but hate clearing the debris manually?

[b]Tidy Farm[/b] allows you to instantly clear your farm of debris with a single button press. It is lightweight, safe for your crops, and highly configurable.


[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41557/41557-1769127288-692050768.gif[/img]﻿﻿[/center]

[size=4][b]Features
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Instant Cleaning:[/b] Press a single hotkey (Default: [b]Z[/b]) to scan the entire farm map and vanish debris instantly.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Crop Safe:[/b] The mod explicitly ignores tilled soil and crops. Your parsnips and pumpkins are 100% safe!
[/list][list]
[*][b]Direct Removal:[/b] Items are deleted directly from the map. This prevents lag and prevents your inventory from overflowing with 999 stone and wood.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Multi-Language Support:[/b] Includes translation support for standard languages.
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41557/41557-1769127128-824320161.png[/img]﻿[size=4][b]What Can It Clean?
[/b][/size]
You can choose exactly what gets removed in the config menu:

[list]
[*][b]Stones:[/b] Small rocks and stones.
[*][b]Twigs:[/b] Small wood pieces.
[*][b]Weeds:[/b] Fiber plants and weeds.
[*][b]Saplings:[/b] Tree seeds and baby trees that haven't fully grown yet. (Does not remove full-grown trees).
[*][b]Grass:[/b] The fodder grass animals eat (Disabled by default).
[*][b]Large Resources:[/b] Hardwood stumps and Boulders (Disabled by default).
[/list]

[center][youtube]k3fp67OxGsI[/youtube]﻿[/center][size=4][b]Configuration
[/b][/size]
This mod is fully compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url]. You can change settings in-game without restarting.

[list]
[*][b]Clean Key:[/b] Change the hotkey (Default: Z).
[*][b]Toggles:[/b] Enable or disable cleaning for specific item types.
[/list][size=4][b]Installation
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the [b]FarmCleaner[/b] folder into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.
[*]Run the game and press [b]Z[/b] to clean!
[/list]
